scenes.title: Home to Room Eight
scenes.summary: After settling the retired mapmaker happily at table one under the shade tree, Qing, Zhou, and Hao step to the front desk to fetch the green guest book and brass key number 8.

scenes.title: Slices of Summer Cake
scenes.summary: At the bustling café counter, Mei plates generous slices of berry-and-almond cake while Peng and Qing report that the honoured guest called it identical to thirty summers ago.

scenes.title: The Four-Hand Duet
scenes.summary: Inside Room 9, Song and Hao perform their joyful four-hand piano duet through the open shutters to warm applause from all twenty-eight courtyard seats.

scenes.title: The Illustrated Map Gift
scenes.summary: Under the shade tree, Qing reads the retired mapmaker's warm written toast aloud while Zhou and Mei unveil his gift: a framed watercolour map of Wutong Lane with Courtyard Inn glowing at its centre.

scenes.title: A New Tin for Tomorrow
scenes.summary: As early evening settles in, Chen surprises Qing inside Room 9 with a brand-new brass-rimmed tin box and waxed linen to seal a new time capsule for thirty summers ahead.

scenes.title: Four Small Keepsakes
scenes.summary: Around the Room 9 table, Mei, Song, and Peng place the complete laminated berry-cake recipe, the signed waltz sheet, wooden clothespin number 9, and a fresh group sketch into the new tin.

scenes.title: Back Under the Third Stone
scenes.summary: Under twenty-four glowing lanterns at twilight, Chen, Zhou, and Qing lower the new waxed-cloth capsule into the brick pocket beneath the third flagstone north of the shade tree.

scenes.title: The Autumn Festival Envelope
scenes.summary: Hanging the framed watercolour map beside the front desk at nine in the evening, Qing and Zhou discover an official municipal envelope from Peng inviting Courtyard Inn into the autumn Historic Courtyard Festival.
